data_fields.name: full_speed_threshold_forward
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.7 (y_forceMaxStrafeThreshold; applied to the vertical axis, forward and reverse)

best_idea: A phone stick reaches full speed before full throw (0.7 of the throw after the deadzone), reverses at a quarter speed, and keeps separate forward and strafe rates whose summed velocity is capped at the forward rate.
decision_why: The full-speed thresholds, the reverse ratio and the 2:1 forward-to-strafe ratio are the data a small phone stick needs; the donor's per-axis deadzone gives an 11.8% diagonal boost and the binding path steps from 0 to 0.2, so the deadzone shape comes from STJr-SRB2 (cell 1) and the velocity is capped.
acceptance: On a 375-wide phone with a 25% deadzone, a thumb at half throw up moves forward at about 48% speed, full speed is reached at about 77% of throw, and a full 45 degree push is no faster than a full straight push; a test asserts the summed velocity never exceeds fwdRate times speedFactor for any stick input.
